meta.title: Submitting an award on a revised bid is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “A few bids have been revised. Please re-award to continue.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Submitting an award on a revised bid is refused

expected.message: A few bids have been revised. Please re-award to continue.
